Trong trường hợp bạn mua bảo hiểm hàng h.en: In the event that you're buying goods insurance, usually at a cost of about 5% of the singles, businesses will make sure 100% of the application value is paid to the guests if there's an unfortunate loss in the delivery process.
Trong trường hợp bạn mua bảo hiểm hàng h.zh: 在购买商品保险时,通常花费约5%的单曲,如果送货过程中出现不幸损失,企业会确保100%的应用价值支付给客人.

Tùy theo bạn chọn đơn vị vận chuyển hàng.en: It's up to you to choose the freight unit and the kind of services that time transportation will vary. Usually, to transport goods from Vietnam to Thailand quickly would take about 4 to 5 days and slow can take from 7 days to 2 weeks at a time. The difference in how fast or slow the delivery time is between the two transport services can affect both the quality of the goods. Therefore, you need to consider carefully before choosing.
Tùy theo bạn chọn đơn vị vận chuyển hàng.zh: 由你来选择货运单位和时间运输会不同的服务类型. 通常,从越南向泰国快速运送货物需要约4至5天的时间,而慢的速度每次需要7天到2周的时间. 两种运输服务在交付时间方面有多快或慢的不同,会影响到货物的质量。 因此,在选择之前,你需要仔细考虑。
